gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-pridi: Commanding up top, Cherry Swash bends its c wide like a horseshoe and gives diagonals real heft. And Pridi, a serif, lets small letters stand nearly capital-sized, so the body's lowercase rises above the heading's moderate one.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-scope-one: Distinctive on sight, Cherry Swash gives its diagonals the full strength of its verticals. Then Scope One, a serif, spills its counters open and pairs stubby ascenders with a high x-height, a taller lowercase than the heading's.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-slabo-13px: Loud and swashy, Cherry Swash flares its horseshoe c and leans on weighty diagonals. Then Slabo 13px steps in with bookish, dignified letters whose large counters keep the tall a, s and e clearly open.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-suwannaphum: A horseshoe-wide c gives Cherry Swash its signature look. Cherry Swash commands attention with hairline-free strokes, while Suwannaphum lifts its x-height high, like squared-off woodblock type, for dignified text.
gen-gf-chilanka-fs-amulya: Amulya, a sans, keeps its curves modern and generously open. Chilanka adds relaxed, hand-drawn grace in plain, unshaded lines up top, though the pair isn't built for long paragraphs.
gen-gf-chilanka-fs-neco: Neco carries an authoritative, dignified voice, its stroke swelling gently from hairline to stem and its curves never pinching shut. Chilanka sketches the relaxed hand; Neco lends formal weight to a few words.
gen-gf-chilanka-fs-plein: Reliable and clean, the body text opens a clear channel into every round letter. Plein, a sans-serif, suits quick glances rather than pages of reading, while Chilanka adds a relaxed hand above.
gen-gf-chilanka-fs-recia: Recia reads sharp, with its light modulation showing mainly up close. What lifts the pair is the hand-drawn grace of Chilanka against that authoritative edge, though it wants short lines, not long paragraphs.
gen-gf-chilanka-fs-spline-sans: Chilanka looks hand-drawn, its strokes holding a single thickness. Spline Sans, a sans with wide gaps and identical stroke weights, gives the loose handwriting a modern anchor, though not for long paragraphs.
gen-gf-chilanka-fs-synonym: Graceful and loose, Chilanka draws every stroke by hand. Synonym, a sans, settles beneath it in a plain stripe of constant ink, so the combination is meant for a few words, not pages.
